what: CRITICAL PROCESS RULE: After spinning off implementation agents, ALWAYS review every agent's changes line-by-line against the plan BEFORE committing. Agents have limited context and can miss parts of the plan. I have more context than they do — the review is my responsibility. Never trust "all tests pass" as proof of completeness. Check each plan item was actually implemented, not just that nothing broke.
why: User called out that I committed 3 agents' work without verifying the ID-based check was implemented. It wasn't — the agent only did half of item 3. Tests passing doesn't mean the plan was fully executed.
